about: The Nightmare (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Nightmare) and Phosani's Nightmare (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Phosani%27s_Nightmare), as captured (rsprox captures, rev 227-237). Arena tiles are the cache map's (the dream copies them unturned). See docs/nightmare.md.

instance.about: As captured (rebuild_region): the dream copies the map square around the arena unturned. Ours takes the 8x8 chunks from chunk (480, 1240), planes 0-3, which hold every plane-2 and plane-3 chunk the capture sends.

arena.about: The floor between the totems (the claws' and sleepwalkers' tiles all fall inside it), and the tile the Nightmare's 5x5 body stands on at the centre.

lobby.about: Where the sleeping Nightmare lies, where the dream lets the player go, and where a death in it wakes them (by the Pool of Nightmares since August 2025, Wiki).

varbits.about: busy and minimap_state as every trip captured; nightmare_first_entry turns Shura into her Collect variant, nightmare_challenge_first_entry Sister Senga; nightmare_challenge_enabled shows the Pool of Nightmares' options (multiloc 29710); parasite turns the hitpoints orb pink.

entry.warning: You are about to begin an encounter with the Nightmare. Dying during this encounter will not be considered a safe death. Are you sure you wish to begin?
entry.phosaniWarning: You are about to begin an encounter with Phosani's Nightmare. Dying during this encounter will not be considered a safe death. Are you sure you wish to begin?
entry.question: Are you sure you wish to begin?
entry.pulled: The Nightmare pulls you into her dream as you approach her.
entry.phosaniPulled: The Nightmare pulls you into Phosani's dream as you drink from the pool.
entry.inProgress: The Nightmare is already fighting someone. You'll have to wait for the fight to end.

leave.question: Are you sure you want to leave?
leave.message: You pull yourself out of the dream.

countdown.about: Ticks before she wakes that each 'will awaken in' message is sent (30s, 20s, 10s, 5s); Phosani's starts at 10s, and her next kill reawakens on the same 10s.
countdown.message: The Nightmare will awaken in [n] seconds!
countdown.reawaken: The Nightmare will reawaken in [n] seconds!

fight.about: Wiki: 2,400 hitpoints, 800 a blast; shields of 2,000 (+200 a player past five, at most 19,600) and totems of 300 (+30, at most 2,640); attack speed 6. Phosani's: three shields of 400 and totems of 200 since the June 2025 rework, then 150 hitpoints in the desperation phase.

messages.noEffect: Your attacks have no effect on the Nightmare.
messages.shieldFails: <col=ff3045>As the Nightmare's shield fails, the totems in the area are activated.</col>
messages.charging: <col=ff3045>The Nightmare begins to charge up a devastating attack.</col>
messages.tired: The Nightmare grows tired of your poor effort and removes you from her dream.

attacks.about: As captured: her animation, then on tick 3 the projectile (heights here in the server's units, the capture's rev-237 values over 4) and on tick 4 the hit; melee lands on tick 2. Max hits from the Wiki: 50 melee and 33 magic or ranged, 120% into the wrong prayer and 20% through the right one; Phosani's 73 and 80, blocked in full by the right prayer.

specials.about: As captured: how many of her standard attacks (1 to 5, most often) fall between specials, and the ticks each special holds her before her next attack.

phosaniSets.about: What each of Phosani's phase forms uses (captured): a spawn, a special paired with the claws, and curse or surge.

chain.about: Phosani's: a run of claws, one every 5 ticks, with her flowers or spores.

husks.trance: <col=ff289d>The Nightmare puts you in a strange trance, preventing you from moving!</col>
husks.free: <col=229628>As the last husk dies, you feel yourself become free of the Nightmare's trance.</col>

flowers.about: She leaves, comes back at the centre and splits the arena with a cross of flowers through (3872, 9951): one quadrant, between two lines of white petals, is safe. Captured ticks from her segment animation.
flowers.message: <col=a53fff>The Nightmare splits the area into segments!</col>

curse.message: <col=a53fff>The Nightmare has cursed you, shuffling your prayers!</col>
curse.end: <col=229628>You feel the effects of the Nightmare's curse wear off.</col>
curse.about: In every capture the prayer the player clicks is the one that turns on, so the shuffle is what each protection blocks: (Wiki) Magic stops missiles, Missiles melee and Melee magic; Phosani's the other way round.

parasite.infected: <col=ff289d>The Nightmare has impregnated you with a deadly parasite!</col>
parasite.weakened: <col=229628>The parasite within you has been weakened.</col>
parasite.nothing: You haven't got anything capable of weakening the parasite.
parasite.burstWeak: <col=ff3045>The parasite bursts out of you, weakened by your potion!</col>
parasite.burstFull: <col=ff3045>The parasite bursts out of you, fully grown!</col>

spores.infected: <col=ff289d>The Nightmare's spores have infected you, making you feel drowsy!</col>

surge.about: Captured: she leaves (her flowers' leave animation), two ticks later is at a lane's start, and four ticks after that surges to its end in one tick. The lanes are the tiles her 5x5 body starts from and ends on.
surge.message: <col=ff3045>The Nightmare surges across the room, damaging you as she does!</col>

sleepwalkers.about: Captured: two ticks after she takes her blast form, sleepwalkers rise beside the totems and walk to her from the fourth tick; she blasts 11 ticks after they rise and the blast lands on the player two ticks after its graphic. The Wiki's numbers: 5 damage with none absorbed, rising to a kill with all of them; Phosani's 5 + 144 x absorbed / spawned (149 with none killed).

kill.phosaniCount: Your Phosani's Nightmare kill count is: <col=ff0000>[n]</col>.

retrieval.about: Wiki: a death in the dream leaves the player's items with Shura (Sister Senga for Phosani's), returned for a flat 60,000 coins.
retrieval.held: [holder] has retrieved some of your items. You can collect them from her in the Sisterhood Sanctuary.
retrieval.noFee: You need [fee] coins to collect your items.
retrieval.lost: Your items left with [holder] have been lost.
retrieval.partial: [holder] returns what you have room for.
